name: zone-17
prompt: Seamless tileable ground texture for a top-down 2D Korean wuxia (murim) action RPG mobile game. Viewed exactly straight down from above, flat even lighting, no perspective, no horizon, no sky, no characters, no buildings, no text, no border, the pattern fills the whole square edge to edge and repeats naturally. Rich hand-painted ink-and-watercolor texture with fine detail, medium-low contrast so characters stand out on top. Ground: imperial palace courtyard floor of large worn golden-tan stone slabs with very subtle faint cloud carvings, soft and calm, no red lines, no strong borders, warm muted beige-gold tones
